cards.name: Adventurous Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Claim the Firstborn
cards.oracle_text: Gain control of target creature with mana value 3 or less until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Cultivate
cards.oracle_text: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Gift of Estates
cards.oracle_text: If an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for up to three Plains cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Grapeshot
cards.oracle_text:
Grapeshot deals 1 damage to any target.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)

cards.name: Krosan Grip
cards.oracle_text:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Destroy target artifact or enchantment.

cards.name: Memory Lapse
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put it on top of its owner's library instead of into that player's graveyard.

cards.name: Primal Command
cards.oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Target player gains 7 life.
• Put target noncreature permanent on top of its owner's library.
• Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library.
• Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Revitalize
cards.oracle_text:
You gain 3 life.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Strategic Planning
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

cards.name: Tezzeret's Gambit
cards.oracle_text:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
Draw two cards, then proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Thrill of Possibility
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.oracle_text: Target player takes an extra turn after this one.

cards.name: Village Rites
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Draw two cards.

cards.name: Whirlwind Denial
cards.oracle_text: For each spell and ability your opponents control, counter it unless its controller pays {4}.
